claims.claim_text: 一份在 16 張 NVIDIA B300 上對 Qwen3-32B 做全參數微調的現場報告
claims.evidence: We report operational experience full-fine-tuning a 32.76B-parameter dense model (Qwen3-32B) on 16 x NVIDIA B300 (two nodes, FSDP / ZeRO-3)
claims.note: Model name, GPU count and accelerator model all match the abstract exactly.

claims.claim_text: 作者自述是這張加速卡上最早公開的實測帳之一
claims.evidence: -- among the first published field accounts on this accelerator.
claims.note: Post correctly attributes the superlative to the authors themselves (作者自述) and keeps the 'one of' hedge (之一 = among the first).

claims.claim_text: 那張用主機板功耗分辨 compute、通訊、餵資料不及與 deadlock 的判讀表
claims.evidence: A B300-calibrated power-draw triage table that distinguishes compute / communication / data-starvation / checkpoint-or-deadlock / idle by board wattage
claims.note: 主機板功耗 = 'board wattage'. The post enumerates four of the source's five categories (omits idle, compresses 'checkpoint-or-deadlock' to deadlock) — a partial enumeration, not a contradiction.

claims.claim_text: 因為 NCCL 卡住的時候，utilization 讀數仍然是 100%
claims.evidence: (utilization% reads 100% during an NCCL hang)
claims.note: Verbatim parenthetical in the abstract; also the roundup hero's through-line, so load is high.

claims.claim_text: NFS 直讀與預先 tokenize 的快取都落在每秒約 53k tokens，資料集塞得進 page cache，瓶頸其實在算力
claims.evidence: a controlled A/B in which per-step NFS reading matches a pretokenized local cache (~53k tok/s) because the corpus fits in page cache and the job is compute-bound
claims.note: The post's 約 preserves the source's ~ tilde; the causal chain (page cache to compute-bound) is the source's own.

claims.claim_text: 先前被歸咎於儲存的 throughput 崩塌，重新診斷後是 CPU 與 NFS 的競用
claims.evidence: a reconstruction of an earlier 'throughput collapse' as NFS/CPU contention rather than a storage-medium limit
claims.note: 重新診斷 matches 'reconstruction ... rather than a storage-medium limit'.

claims.claim_text: Zig 新的 Io 介面有一個 Threaded 實作，用的是最普通的阻塞式 syscall，卻仍然支援真正的取消
claims.evidence: Zig's Io.Threaded uses blocking syscalls and fully supports cancelation.
claims.note: This is the source's opening line, asserted without hedge; the post matches that strength.

claims.claim_text: matklad 說這個組合他想要很久了
claims.evidence: it does this weird thing that I wanted to do for ages, that to my knowledge no one else is doing properly, and implements it better than I thought to be possible
claims.note: Rendered as indirect attribution (no 「」), so not held to direct-quote fidelity; the referent of 'this weird thing' is the blocking-syscall-plus-cancelation combination described in the same paragraph.

claims.claim_text: 要取消時先設旗標，再對那條執行緒送 signal，syscall 以 EINTR 回來之後執行緒自己判斷該重試還是承認被取消
claims.evidence: The canceling thread sets a flag requesting cancellation, then signals the target thread; a blocked syscall returns EINTR upon signal delivery; the interrupted thread checks the shared flag to determine whether to retry or acknowledge cancellation and unwind.
claims.note: Ordering (flag before signal) and the EINTR retry/acknowledge decision both match the source's protocol description.

claims.claim_text: Windows 上對應的是 NtCancelSynchronousIoFile
claims.evidence: a much more direct NtCancelSynchronousIoFile
claims.note: Named identifier present verbatim in the source.

claims.claim_text: Io 把「可以並行」與「必須並行」分開，所以執行緒池可以重用，不必每次都付出建立執行緒的代價
claims.evidence: Zig's Io interface distinguishes between operations that 'may run concurrently' versus those that 'must run concurrently', enabling thread pool reuse and avoiding expensive thread creation.
claims.note: 「可以並行」/「必須並行」 render 'may run concurrently'/'must run concurrently'; the 「」 mark a translated distinction, not a quoted person.

claims.claim_text: celld 是 Deno Land 開源的自架 Durable Objects：V8 執行程式碼、SQLite 存單一 cell 的狀態、LTX 負責把狀態持續複製到 S3 相容的 bucket
claims.evidence: celld = V8 + SQLite + LTX ... Deno Land Inc. (page footer); repository and image paths given as denoland/celld
claims.note: The V8/SQLite/LTX decomposition and S3-compatible bucket replication are stated on the landing page. The Deno Land attribution rests on the footer copyright plus the denoland/celld GitHub org rather than a body sentence.

claims.claim_text: 設計上最乾脆的一句是「the bucket is the coordinator」
claims.evidence: the bucket is the coordinator
claims.note: Direct quote inside 「」 present verbatim on the page.

claims.claim_text: 沒有成員協定、沒有失效偵測器、沒有共識演算法，所有權租約靠對 bucket 的 compare-and-swap 原子寫入決定
claims.evidence: no membership protocol, no failure detector, no consensus algorithm — cell ownership uses atomic compare-and-swap writes to your bucket
claims.note: Triple negation and the CAS ownership-lease mechanism both present.

claims.claim_text: 官方列出的數字是 RPO 為 0、region 內的持久化寫入約 90 毫秒、節點掉了之後約 20 秒完成 failover 且不掉資料，而一台 8GB 節點約可常駐 1,000 個 cell
claims.evidence: Acknowledged writes lost on kill: 0 / RPO=0 · Durable write latency (region-local): ~90ms · Failover after node loss, 0 lost: ~20s · Resident cells / 8 GB node: 1,000 cells
claims.note: All four figures match the vendor's own metrics table, and the post visibly attributes them (官方列出的數字是), the right handling for high-load single-source vendor numbers. The resident-cell figure is a flat 1,000 in the source and the post adds 約 — deflation, never an error.

claims.claim_text: 同一句 5 億列的 SUM，原生 Postgres 大約要 20 秒
claims.evidence: ~20 seconds (native Postgres, summing 500 million numbers)
claims.note: Source phrases the workload as summing 500 million numbers; the post renders it as 5 億列, the same benchmark.

claims.claim_text: 作者把 pgrust 的執行引擎從 Volcano 模型的 1.3 秒開始往下推：一次處理 1024 列把每列的函式呼叫開銷攤掉，變成 480 毫秒
claims.evidence: Volcano model implementation: 1.3 s -> with batching (1024 rows): 480 ms
claims.note: Baseline, batch size and post-batching timing all match.

claims.claim_text: 把 sequential scan 與聚合融合成單一節點、省掉中間緩衝的複製，變成 358 毫秒
claims.evidence: With operator fusion: 358 ms. 'If there are common operations that we know will be performed together, we can create a single node that replaces two nodes.' ... 'Even though we are now batching, we still need to copy the items into the buffer' — an overhead the fused operator removes.
claims.note: Both the mechanism (single fused node, no intermediate buffer copy) and the 358 ms figure are the source's.

claims.claim_text: 再用 ARM64 NEON 的四個累加器一次吃 8 個值，落到 135 毫秒，機器是 AWS c8g.4xlarge 的 Graviton4
claims.evidence: let mut acc = unsafe { [vdupq_n_f64(0.0); 4] }; ... let (chunks, rest) = self.table.as_chunks::<8>(); ... With SIMD (ARM64 NEON, four accumulators): 135 ms ... AWS c8g.4xlarge (Graviton4, 16 vCPU)
claims.note: Four accumulators and 8-value chunks are both visible in the source's code listing; hardware string matches.

claims.claim_text: pgrust 0.2 對外宣稱的是 ClickBench 上 300 倍於 Postgres、OLTP 上快 30%
claims.evidence: 300x faster than Postgres (Clickbench) ... 30% faster than Postgres (OLTP benchmarks)
claims.note: The post marks these as vendor claims (對外宣稱), matching the source's framing; the article separately notes the query engine accounts for roughly 10x of the 300x.

claims.claim_text: 一個把所有 context 都忽略的模型看起來很穩健，實際上在 context 值得相信的時候一樣沒用
claims.evidence: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting
claims.note: Near-literal rendering of the abstract's framing sentence.

claims.claim_text: 作者提出人工標注的 MIST 基準，同一道推理題渲染成 clean、misleading、correct-context、irrelevant-context 四種對照條件
claims.evidence: we ... introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-context, and irrelevant-context)
claims.note: Benchmark name, human annotation, and all four condition labels match verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 再用 SC2W 這個配對指標數「誤導訊號把原本答對的題目翻成錯」發生了幾次
claims.evidence: together with SC2W, a paired metric counting how often a misleading signal flips a clean-correct answer to wrong
claims.note: The 「」 span is a translation of the metric's definition, not a quoted speaker; definition matches the abstract exactly.

claims.claim_text: 他們的觀察是這種易感性在受測模型上普遍存在
claims.evidence: Across a comprehensive benchmark study, we observe that such a susceptibility is universal.
claims.note: The source says 'universal'; the post scopes it to 受測模型 and attributes it (他們的觀察是). Weaker than the source — deflation, never an error.

claims.claim_text: SCOPE 用四種條件均衡配對的 DPO 目標把 SC2W 明顯壓下來，同時保住 context 乾淨、正確或無關時的正確率
claims.evidence: optimizes a standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) objective over matched preference pairs balanced equally across all four conditions ... Our approach substantially reduces SC2W on popular open-sourced models while preserving accuracy when the added context is clean, correct, or irrelevant.
claims.note: 明顯壓下來 corresponds to 'substantially reduces'; the accuracy-preservation clause matches the three named conditions.

claims.claim_text: 數學上 a > b > 1 時 log_a(x) 應該小於 log_b(x)，但在 PHP 與 Lua（LuaJIT 除外）裡不一定成立
claims.evidence: For bases where a > b > 1 and x > 1, log_a(x) < log_b(x) ... 'PHP and Lua (excluding LuaJIT) don't always use the ln x / ln a formula.'
claims.note: The LuaJIT exclusion is the source's own parenthetical, reproduced faithfully.

claims.claim_text: 作者給的反例是 x = 2.93、a = 10 + 2^-49、b = 10：這兩個底數的自然對數在這兩個語言裡會捨入成同一個值，最後算出來的結果卻不同
claims.evidence: 'Even more weird is the fact that if you actually compute ln a and ln b in PHP or Lua, you'll find out that they round to the same value!' — with the counterexample given as x = 2.93, a = 10 + 2^(-49), b = 10.
claims.note: All three constants match. The source shows the code but does not print outputs, so the differing-results half rests on the article's assertion rather than a displayed transcript.

claims.claim_text: 底數是 2 或 10 時直接呼叫 libm 的 log2 與 log10，兩條計算路徑的誤差方向不同，單調性就這樣斷了
claims.evidence: For the bases that libm implements directly, i.e. base 10 and base 2, they call the corresponding functions (log10 and log2) without going through the natural logarithm.
claims.note: The two-code-path root cause is the source's own explanation; the article's note that the two methods produce different error patterns supports the divergent-error clause.

claims.claim_text: 查一個保留名稱 _dns.resolver.arpa，resolver 回來的答案帶著主機名、連接埠、協定與偏好順序
claims.evidence: '_dns.resolver.arpa' ... 'the hostname, port, and protocol of each encrypted endpoint', along with preference rankings for the device to follow.
claims.note: Reserved name and all four answer fields match.

claims.claim_text: 裝置挑一個 DoH、DoT 或 DoQ 的端點接上去，之後的查詢就是加密的
claims.evidence: The system supports DoH, DoT, and DoQ as encrypted DNS options.
claims.note: Protocol list matches exactly.

claims.claim_text: 從明文 DNS 起手的升級是 opportunistic 的，網路可以竄改或拿掉這段回覆而不被發現
claims.evidence: A network operator intent on keeping DNS unencrypted can strip or rewrite the reply, and the device has no way to detect it.
claims.note: 竄改或拿掉 = rewrite or strip; 而不被發現 = 'no way to detect it'.

claims.claim_text: 已經在加密連線上發問的裝置可以沿用那條連線的憑證驗證結果
claims.evidence: The exchange happens inside a connection that is already encrypted and certificate-verified, so the upgrade inherits that verification.
claims.note: 沿用 = 'inherits that verification'.

claims.claim_text: 文中順帶提到 Windows 11 與 Apple 裝置在加入網路時就會自動送出這個問題
claims.evidence: Both Windows 11 and Apple devices implement this automatically, sending the discovery query upon joining a network.
claims.note: Post explicitly attributes to the article (文中順帶提到) rather than asserting it independently.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 把 bot 判定從單點的風險評估改成整段 session 的持續信任評估
claims.evidence: Cloudflare is transitioning away from instantaneous risk scoring toward analyzing behavioral patterns throughout an entire user session ... the company now evaluates 'continuous Trust'.
claims.note: Also the hero paragraph's framing (單點檢查等於發免費通行證), so load is high.

claims.claim_text: BotBase 是一份把所有已知 bot 與 agent 都收進來的名錄，不只收核可的那些，判定好行為的標準是誠實自我宣告加上不濫用
claims.evidence: BotBase functions as 'a directory of all known bots and agents' rather than exclusively cataloging approved ones. Good behavior requires: 'declare yourself honestly, and ... not abuse the trust you've earned.'
claims.note: Both the scope contrast and the two-part good-behavior criterion match the source.

claims.claim_text: Precursor 則是透過 CDN 注入的 JavaScript，看游標的加速度、自我修正與節奏這類使用者不會刻意控制的細節
claims.evidence: you're accelerating or correcting yourself, the rhythm and texture of your cursor movement
claims.note: All three named signals appear in the source; the source also lists 'texture', which the post omits — omission, not invention.

claims.claim_text: 他們給的數字是 24 小時內在 73,438 個 zone 上記錄了 2 億 600 萬次 Precursor 評估事件
claims.evidence: 206 million Precursor evaluation events, across 73,438 zones on the Cloudflare network — during a single 24-hour period.
claims.note: 2 億 600 萬 = 206 million; zone count exact. Post attributes to the vendor (他們給的數字是).

claims.claim_text: 可疑行為經常出現在 session 中段，同一段 session 也會在人與 agent 之間切換
claims.evidence: 'suspicious behavior often happens mid-session' ... 'Behavior often shifts from human to agentic and back over a session.'
claims.note: 經常 preserves the source's 'often' hedge in both halves.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 的 Kitesurf 是一顆完全跑在 Workers V8 isolate 裡的瀏覽器
claims.evidence: a stateless, highly scalable, and cost-effective web browser that runs entirely on top of Workers
claims.note: 'runs entirely on top of Workers' supports 完全跑在 Workers 裡; the V8-isolate detail is borne out by the PageScript isolate description.

claims.claim_text: Engine 負責 CDP 與 session、PageScript 用 Rust 編成 WASM 的 Blitz 與 Stylo 做解析與 DOM、PageRenderer 用 Parley 與 blitz-paint 產出像素
claims.evidence: Engine: Handles Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and session state management. 'For parsing the HTML and the CSS we use parts of Blitz, a modular rendering engine, and Stylo, Firefox's high-performance CSS parser, both written in Rust.' PageScript 'handles the page session, consisting of a clean globalThis and the DOM document object.' PageRenderer 'uses blitz-paint ... which in turn uses Parley for shaping the characters into glyphs.'
claims.note: Checked adversarially: Blitz/Stylo do parsing while the DOM document lives in the PageScript isolate, so the post's compressed 做解析與 DOM is attributed to PageScript as a whole and does not misassign DOM ownership to Stylo.

claims.claim_text: 截圖 CPU 380 毫秒對 Chromium 的 1,173 毫秒、記憶體 57.8 MiB 對 271.0 MiB
claims.evidence: CPU (screenshots): '380 ms' vs Chromium's '1,173 ms' ... Memory (screenshots): '57.8 MiB' vs Chromium's '271.0 MiB'
claims.note: All four figures verbatim, and the post correctly scopes them to the screenshot benchmark row.

claims.claim_text: 純執行速度上 Chromium 因為 JIT 仍快 1.7 到 1.8 倍
claims.evidence: 'Wall time: screenshot | 1,148 ms | 637 ms | 1.8x slower than Chromium'; 'Wall time: HTML extraction | 820 ms | 472 ms | 1.7x slower than Chromium'; 'Chromium wins the stopwatch because a JIT that has already seen this page always beats a cold software renderer — and today it does, by about 1.7x.'
claims.note: The 1.7-1.8x range spans the two wall-time rows and the JIT attribution is the source's own. Checked adversarially because this is a concession against the post's own framing — it holds up.

claims.claim_text: 影片播放、WebGL、bot challenge 與長時間的登入 session 都不在適用範圍
claims.evidence: Kitesurf cannot yet handle video playback, WebGL rendering, sophisticated bot-challenge authentication, or persistent multi-session authentication states.
claims.note: All four exclusions present; post drops the source's 'yet', a minor deflation of temporariness rather than an inflation.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 原生的 stacked pull requests 進入 public preview，把一次大改動拆成有順序的多個 PR，每一層以下一層為 base
claims.evidence: GitHub has released stacked pull requests as a public preview feature ... 'a large change is split into ordered PRs where each layer bases on the one below.'
claims.note: Release stage (public preview) and the stacking model both match the changelog.

claims.claim_text: review 時只看該層自己的 diff，旁邊有一張 stack map 顯示層與層的關係，各層可以平行審而不互相擋
claims.evidence: 'Use the stack map at the top of the pull request to see how the change you're reviewing fits into the larger work.' Reviewers see 'only that layer's own diff' and 'layers to be reviewed in parallel without blocking each other.'
claims.note: 'stack map' is GitHub's own term, confirmed verbatim. One imprecision below the correction bar: the source places the stack map at the top of the PR while the post says 旁邊.

claims.claim_text: 合併時整疊一次併入或一層一層併入都可以，部分合併之後其餘層會自動 rebase
claims.evidence: Teams can merge the entire stack at once or 'merge one layer at a time' with 'remaining layers automatically rebasing after a partial merge.'
claims.note: Both merge modes and the auto-rebase behaviour match.

claims.claim_text: 既有的 branch protection 與 required check 照常生效，唯一還沒到位的是 merge queue，官方說會在接下來幾週陸續開放
claims.evidence: 'Existing branch protection and required checks still apply.' Merge queue support is 'not yet supported and will roll out in the coming weeks.'
claims.note: 官方說 correctly marks the roadmap statement as GitHub's forward-looking claim; 接下來幾週 matches 'in the coming weeks'. 唯一 compresses the changelog's single stated limitation.
